# Leeam Applications

> Leeam Applications is an independent app studio from Northamptonshire, UK, run by Liam and Lee. Our aim is simple: apps that work for everyone, designed from day one for blind and visually impaired people and made for all.

## About Leeam Applications

- Leeam Applications is a small, independent app studio based in Northamptonshire, United Kingdom, founded and run by two friends, Liam and Lee.
- One of the two founders is blind and uses a screen reader every day. Everything Leeam Applications makes is built and tested with a screen reader from the very first day, and is designed to work for everyone.
- The studio builds simple, helpful apps for iPhone and Android.
- Contact: info@leeamapplications.com
- Website: https://leeamapplications.com/

## Apps

- RYX: AI Voice Calendar and Tasks. Tap the orb, say what you need, and RYX puts it in your calendar or your to-do list. It answers questions about your day, finds your free time and reminds you when it matters. It works beautifully with VoiceOver and TalkBack. RYX is made by Leeam Applications.
- Where to get RYX today: an iPhone beta through Apple TestFlight at https://testflight.apple.com/join/HhPnMHfr. Coming soon to Google Play.
- RYX website: https://ryxapp.com
